heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: Rotating gliding arc: conical Cu inner electrode (32 mm, water-cooled ~20 degC, HV); SS outer electrode ID 36.2 mm (grounded, not cooled); min gap ~2.1 mm; four 2 mm tangential inlets; nozzle + 16 mm tubular outlet; water-cooled quenching rod (QR, ~7 degC) 20 mm from outlet
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The RGA reactor comprises an inner electrode, an external electrode with four tangential inlets, a nozzle outlet, and a quenching rod (QR).

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: AC supply up to 2 kW, several kV, several hundred mA, ~20 kHz; HV probe P6015A and current probe TCP0150 on oscilloscope; P = (1/T) integral V I dt
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The plasma power was calculated by integrating the product of the voltage and current over time
basis_and_boundary: Discharge power at the reactor; supply wall power not reported

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: set 1000-1800 W (SEI 2.5-4.5 kJ/L nominal); measured SEI 2.3-4.2 kJ/L

heading: Operating conditions
evidence_excerpt_or_description: the mixture of four different CH4/CO2 ratios (i.e., 1/3, 1/2, 5/7, and 1) was injected while the N2 flow rate and total flow rate were kept at 12 and 24 SLPM
basis_and_boundary: 50% N2 diluent
uncertainty: SLPM reference state not stated (0 degC assumed; reproduces author eta)

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: 5 min feed flush; 10 min heat-up/stabilisation after ignition; sample; then 3 min CO2 flow with power on to remove carbon from electrodes; repeated three times
evidence_excerpt_or_description: to remove deposited carbon from the electrodes, CO2 was supplied for 3 min while the power supply was turned on. This procedure was repeated three times
basis_and_boundary: Short runs; no long time on stream
notes: Periodic CO2 cleaning needed: durability issue
